title: Looking towards the blunt cape
html_source:
Bray Head is not visible from the Joyce Tower – one of very few mistakes in Ulysses. Joyce wrote Ulysses whilst in Trieste (there’s as much of the Triestine melting pot in Ulysses as there is of the Dublin) and other European cities: the footnote at the end of the epic reads “Trieste-Zurich-Paris, 1914-1921”. Although he used friends and family to check Dublin details meticulously, he failed in this case.

This is the view from the Joyce Tower looking towards Bray – Dalkey blocks the great cape of Bray Head:
